#!/bin/sh
# Queue only. Kernel-install can execute before matching kernel-devel and akmods.
set -eu
case "${1-}" in
    add|remove)
        /usr/libexec/nvidia-vbios lifecycle queue "$1" "${2-}"
        ;;
esac

[Unit]
Description=Validate and reconcile NVIDIA VBIOS override for the latest Fedora kernel
After=local-fs.target akmods.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/nvidia-vbios/lifecycle.json
ConditionPathExists=!/run/ostree-booted

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# Block ordinary shutdown/reboot while a build or boot publication is in progress.
ExecStart=/usr/bin/systemd-inhibit --what=shutdown:sleep --mode=block --who=nvidia-vbios --why=Validating-NVIDIA-kernel-update /usr/libexec/nvidia-vbios lifecycle reconcile
TimeoutStartSec=2h
UMask=0077
Nice=10
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/nvidia-vbios /etc/nvidia-vbios /usr/lib/modules /usr/lib/firmware/nvidia /boot /run/akmods /usr/lib/sysimage/rpm

[Unit]
Description=Queue NVIDIA reconciliation after update requests or enrollment changes
ConditionPathExists=/etc/nvidia-vbios/lifecycle.json

[Path]
PathChanged=/var/lib/nvidia-vbios/lifecycle/pending
PathChanged=/etc/nvidia-vbios/lifecycle.json
Unit=nvidia-vbios-reconcile.service

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=Retry blocked NVIDIA kernel updates and audit the ready deployment
ConditionPathExists=/etc/nvidia-vbios/lifecycle.json

[Timer]
OnBootSec=3min
OnUnitInactiveSec=15min
RandomizedDelaySec=30s
Unit=nvidia-vbios-reconcile.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# Install in /etc/dnf/libdnf5-plugins/actions.d/; requires libdnf5-plugin-actions.
# Host-only, once per transaction; propagate failures instead of logging success.
# Options use spaces as required by libdnf5-actions >= 1.4.0.
post_transaction:::enabled=host-only raise_error=1:/usr/libexec/nvidia-vbios lifecycle post-transaction

# Install in /etc/dnf/plugins/post-transaction-actions.d/; requires DNF4 actions plugin.
# DNF4 deduplicates identical commands across matching packages.
*:any:/usr/libexec/nvidia-vbios lifecycle post-transaction
